Good to know before you come.

Still wondering? Message us on WhatsApp and we'll answer in a few minutes.

Chat with Us on WhatsApp
Do I need prior painting experience?

Not at all! Our DIY painting experience is beginner-friendly. Just bring your creativity and have fun. No artistic skills required.

What is included in the DIY Art Kit?

Your kit includes a canvas, acrylic paints and brushes, with an easel and apron provided at the café. Take your masterpiece home! 🎨

How much does painting cost?

Our DIY Art Kit is available for just ₹249 per person when you order 1 food item and 1 beverage per person. Your total spend will be approximately ₹700 per person, depending on your menu choices. Prefer just the art experience? The DIY Art Kit is priced at ₹999 per person. 🎨

Can I visit just for painting without ordering food?

Yes! You can enjoy the DIY Art Kit at the studio price of ₹999 per person. For our special café rate of ₹249 per person, each person needs to order at least one food item and one beverage.

Is ordering food and beverages mandatory to get the DIY Art Kit at ₹249?

Yes, the discounted ₹249 café rate applies when each person orders at least one food item and one beverage. If you prefer the painting experience without this order, the studio price is ₹999 per person.

Can I share a DIY Art Kit with others?

Each DIY Art Kit is for one person and is not shareable. Everyone participating in the painting activity needs their own kit.

Is painting compulsory?

Not at all! You're welcome to visit Artizen just to enjoy our food and beverages. The painting experience is entirely optional.

How long does the painting activity take?

Most guests spend approximately 1.5 to 2 hours painting, depending on their artwork and pace.

How long can I stay at the café?

On weekends, seating is limited to 2 hours. On weekdays, you can enjoy up to 2.5 hours, subject to availability and waiting guests.

Do I need to book a table?

We welcome walk-ins only! For groups of more than 8 people, reach out to us on WhatsApp to plan your Artizen experience. 🎨

Can we host a birthday or a team outing?

Yes. Tell us the date, the group size and the occasion, and we'll set up the table before you arrive.

Can I bring my own art supplies, food or beverages?

No, outside art supplies, food and beverages are not permitted at Artizen.

Can I bring my pet?

Absolutely! Artizen is a pet-friendly space. 🐾

Can I work from the café?

Artizen is designed for you to take a break from your screens, slow down and enjoy a creative experience. We encourage you to unplug and be present rather than use the café as a workspace.

Is there a service charge?

No. We don't add a service charge. Kindness is our favourite ingredient.

Can I take my art home the same day?

Yes. Your art goes home with you.

Which café should I visit?

Both serve the full menu and art kits. Baner is on Baner Pashan Link Road in west Pune. Our new café is in Kalyani Nagar in east Pune, near Jogger's Park. Pick whichever is closer.

Two cafés. Pick the closer one.
